scope_tr: İşin Kapsamı: Fernas-4 GES projesi Yap-işlet modeli ile yapılacak bir proje olup 20 MW kurulu güce sahip olacaktır. Proje kapsamında mühendislik, malzeme temini, montaj ve devreye alma işleri yapılacaktır.
scope_en: Scope of Work: Fernas-4 SPP project will be done as built-operate and transfer and it will have 20 MW installed power. As a part of Project engineering, supply of material, montage and start up works will be done.

body_html_en: Scope of Work: Fernas-4 SPP project will be done as built-operate and transfer and it will have 20 MW installed power. As a part of Project  engineering, supply of material, montage and start up  works will be done.
